sentences.text: Back to the Future Part II is a 1989 American science-fiction adventure comedy film directed by Robert Zemeckis and written by Bob Gale .	Robert Zemeckis	Robert Zemeckis	Bob Gale	Bob Gale	science-fiction	Science fiction film	adventure	Adventure film	comedy film	comedy film	Back to the Future	Back to the Future
It is the sequel to the 1985 film Back to the Future and the second installment in the Back to the Future trilogy .	Back to the Future	Back to the Future

The film stars Michael J. Fox , Christopher Lloyd , Thomas F. Wilson , and Lea Thompson and continues immediately following the original film .	Michael J. Fox	Michael J. Fox	Christopher Lloyd	Christopher Lloyd	Lea Thompson	Lea Thompson	Thomas F. Wilson	Thomas F. Wilson

After repairing the damage to history done by his previous time travel adventures , Marty McFly -LRB- Fox -RRB- and his friend Dr. Emmett `` Doc '' Brown -LRB- Lloyd -RRB- travel to 2015 to prevent McFly 's future son from ending up imprisoned .	time travel	time travel	Marty McFly	Marty McFly

However , their presence allows Biff Tannen -LRB- Wilson -RRB- to steal Doc 's DeLorean time machine and travel to 1955 , where he alters history by making his younger self wealthy .	Biff Tannen	Biff Tannen	DeLorean time machine	DeLorean time machine
The film was produced on a $ 40-million budget and was filmed back-to-back with its sequel , Part III .	back-to-back	Back to back film production	Part III	Back to the Future Part III
Filming began in February 1989 after two years were spent building the sets and writing the scripts .
Two actors from the first film , Crispin Glover and Claudia Wells , did not return for the final two .	Crispin Glover	Crispin Glover	Claudia Wells	Claudia Wells

While Elisabeth Shue was recast in the role of Wells ' character , Jennifer , Glover 's character , George McFly , was not only minimized in the plot , but also was obscured and recreated with another actor .	Elisabeth Shue	Elisabeth Shue	George McFly	George McFly
Glover successfully sued both Zemeckis and Gale , changing how producers can deal with the departure and replacement of actors in a role .

Back to the Future Part II was also a ground-breaking project for effects studio Industrial Light & Magic -LRB- ILM -RRB- : In addition to digital compositing , ILM used the VistaGlide motion control camera system , which allowed an actor to portray multiple characters simultaneously on-screen without sacrificing camera movement .	Back to the Future	Back to the Future	Industrial Light & Magic	Industrial Light & Magic	digital compositing	digital compositing
Back to the Future Part II was released by Universal Pictures on November 22 , 1989 .	Universal Pictures	Universal Studios	Back to the Future	Back to the Future

The film received mixed reviews from critics and grossed over $ 331 million worldwide , making it the third-highest-grossing film of 1989 .	third-highest-grossing film of 1989	1989 in film#Highest-grossing films
